name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
one_liner: A free, extremely thorough course that teaches you AI engineering from the basics all the way to shipping a real product.
buyer: An aspiring AI engineer, or a bootcamp operator who wants proven curriculum content instead of building lessons from scratch.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp adapts the curriculum structure to launch a paid 'AI Engineer' cohort program.
A corporate L&D team uses it as a self-paced internal upskilling track for engineers moving into AI roles.
A YouTuber turns individual lessons into a paid video course with added exercises and feedback.

money_ideas.idea: Build a paid, cohort-based bootcamp with mentorship and code review layered on top of this free curriculum.
Sell a 'graded exercises plus certificate' add-on since the base content is free.

steal_this: Turn the first ten lessons into a paid weekend workshop with live Q&A, using the free content as your syllabus.
